svg.aria-label: Luau reactivity benchmark results, lower is faster
svg.text: headless luau 0.746 -O2 · per-bench process isolation · normalized per row to the fastest (shorter = faster)
over 23 of 23 rows · DNF charged the 8s per-run deadline
teardown & GCdispose cost, reclaim time, and live-graph tracing time
memory60k-node graph · footprint ×leanest, retention scaled to 23.0 MB leanest graph (~0 = fully released) · excluded from the overall geometric mean
Port of milomg/js-reactivity-benchmark · normalized per row to the fastest framework (1.0×, shorter = faster) · process-isolated, upstream's warm-ups and fastest-of-N (cellx: mean).
Faded bars exceed 10× (true multiple labeled) · every non-finishing run (DNF) is charged the 8s per-run deadline in the geomean.
evals = computed + effect bodies run per kairo iteration / cellx propagation / dynamic run · run-to-run noise is about ±10% even with fastest-of-N and several passes, so treat smaller gaps as ties.
